RefreshU does not sell, underwrite, interpret, or guarantee insurance coverage or claims, and does not determine whether a policy will cover a particular loss, medical event, procedure-related issue, cancellation or rescheduling.
Travel policies may exclude elective procedures, expected medical treatment, complications, pre-existing conditions, or related cancellations. You must verify coverage directly with the insurer.

Relevant categories may include trip cancellation and interruption, travel delay, baggage, emergency medical care, and emergency evacuation or repatriation. This list does not mean every policy covers elective-procedure-related events.

Information may come directly from you, your authorized representative, participating providers, service providers, payment processors, travel vendors, or your browser and device as applicable.

Under the current architecture the Platform does not collect, receive, store, transmit, process or display the medical screening questionnaire or its answers, clinical photographs, laboratory or diagnostic results, or physicians’ clinical notes. That material passes directly between you and the participating physician’s own system. The Platform records that a referral occurred, its status, and the operational instructions the physician releases.

Depending on use, RefreshU may collect identity and contact information; account credentials; procedure interests; physician-review status; communications; travel itinerary; accommodation and transportation information; emergency contact; travel-insurance proof; payment and transaction information; device and security logs; and cookie or analytics data on applicable pages.
